meaning: Exact unchanged whole dependency layers are reused byte-for-byte. Newly rebuilt terminal rlibs are newly qualified: all object payloads, symbol indexes and lib.rmeta are byte-exact; compiler-session rcgu member names differ only in the ar long-name table and nonallocated linker metadata. Explicit bijections verify every such byte. This is not whole-rlib byte identity; no capture payload normalization, donor execution or transplant.
